Record ONLY information literally present on a real page you actually fetched with WebFetch. Leave any field BLANK ("") if not publicly available. A missing email is CORRECT; a made-up email is a critical failure. Accuracy > count. Respect site ToS/robots.txt; do NOT bypass anti-bot protections. Prefer official business websites and openly-fetchable public directory listings. If a directory (Yelp, etc.) blocks WebFetch, skip it — do not invent.

METHOD: For each industry, use WebSearch to find real Cleveland businesses (e.g. "Cleveland Ohio HVAC company"), then WebFetch each business's own website (and/or a public directory listing) and extract ONLY what's actually shown. Aim for 8-12 REAL businesses total with spread across the 5 industries. Fewer real/verified is better than padded.

NAICS hints: plumbers 238220, HVAC 238220, electricians 238210, roofers 238160, landscapers 561730.

OUTPUT: Write a JSON array (only these records) to /tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/leads/cleveland.json with exactly these keys per record: businessName, category, subcategory, naics, contactFirstName, contactLastName, contactTitle, businessEmail, generalEmail, phone, website, address, city, state, zip, linkedin, facebook, instagram, websiteQuality, hasWebsite, mobileFriendly, ssl, onlineBooking, ecommerce, clearCta, leadScore, leadTier, sourceUrl, verificationStatus, notes. Return a short summary: how many real records written, industry spread, and any access limits hit.
